query: Assess this proposed change across the supplied repositories. Identify behavior that breaks, repositories needing production changes, validation-only obligations, directed contract dependencies, and a sufficient repair plan. Preserve the requested change and the stated compatibility requirements. Support findings with source evidence and state unresolved claims.

proposed_change.diff:
--- a/src/main/resources/db/migration/V3__private_price_column.sql
+++ b/src/main/resources/db/migration/V3__private_price_column.sql
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+ALTER TABLE products RENAME COLUMN price_minor TO unit_price_minor;
--- a/src/main/resources/mybatis/mapper/ProductMapper.xml
+++ b/src/main/resources/mybatis/mapper/ProductMapper.xml
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
 <mapper namespace="com.poc.catalog.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.ProductMapper">
 
     <sql id="columns">
-        id, name, description, image_url AS imageUrl, price_minor AS priceMinor,
+        id, name, description, image_url AS imageUrl, unit_price_minor AS priceMinor,
         currency, active, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
     </sql>
 
@@ -34,7 +34,7 @@
 
     <update id="updatePrice">
         UPDATE products
-        SET price_minor = #{priceMinor},
+        SET unit_price_minor = #{priceMinor},
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = #{id}
     </update>
